python - <<'PY'
from math import gcd
from more_itertools import all_equal, totient
import doctest
import more_itertools.recipes as recipes

assert all_equal([])
assert all_equal([1])
assert all_equal([1, 1], key=None)
assert not all_equal([1, 2])
assert all_equal('AaAa', key=str.lower)
assert not all_equal('AaAb', key=str.lower)
assert all_equal(['a', 'b'], lambda x: [len(x)])
assert all_equal([], key=lambda x: 1 / 0)
assert all_equal(iter([1, 3, 5]), key=lambda x: x % 2)
assert not all_equal(iter([1, 3, 4]), key=lambda x: x % 2)
for n in range(1, 1001):
    assert totient(n) == sum(gcd(n, k) == 1 for k in range(1, n + 1)), n
result = doctest.testmod(recipes)
assert result.failed == 0, result
print('Targeted checks and recipe doctests passed:', result)
PY
